description: Use this tool to check whether a contract impersonates a known mainstream asset (e.g. a fake 'USDC'), using GoPlus's fake_token/trust_list/honeypot_with_same_creator fields - same underlying token_security call as security.token_risk / contract_health_audit / token_prescreen, no extra upstream cost. flagged_as_counterfeit=false is NOT proof of authenticity - it only means GoPlus found no such flag at query time. true_token_address is only set when flagged_as_counterfeit is true. No honeypot/tax/LP checks here - use security.token_risk / security.contract_health_audit for those. Paid in USDC on Base.

chain_id.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 8453 for Base.

name: security.token_authenticity

flagged_as_counterfeit.description: True when GoPlus's fake_token.value == 1. False means no such flag was found (not proof of authenticity). Null only when the GoPlus lookup itself failed.

honeypot_with_same_creator.description: Count of other honeypot-flagged tokens deployed by the same creator address, per GoPlus.

true_token_address.description: Only non-null when flagged_as_counterfeit is true - GoPlus's claimed address of the genuine asset being impersonated, on the same chain.

trust_list.description: True when GoPlus's trust_list flags this contract as a known, trustworthy token. Sparsely populated - absent/false does not imply risk.
